title: Removing a final skip
statement: For any limit record, program, execution depth, state $\sigma$, budget $T$, statement $s$, and postcondition $Q$, if the sequence consisting of $s$ followed by skip can execute from $\sigma$ with cost at most $T$ and end in a state satisfying $Q$, then $s$ itself can execute from $\sigma$ with cost at most $T$ and end in a state satisfying $Q$.
hypotheses_covered: The sequence s followed by skip executes from σ within budget T and ends in a state satisfying Q.
